data.reason: Manufactures locks, hinges and hardware for equipment makers; lacks AZZ's galvanizing services and electrical products.
Manufactures locks, hardware and metal components for OEMs; no galvanizing or coating services or utility-focused electrical products.

AZZ is a metal coatings service provider (hot-dip galvanizing and coil coating) that charges fees to process customers' steel and metal for infrastructure, fabrication and building markets. Eastern is a holding company of engineered hardware makers: returnable packaging and blow-mold tools, access and security hardware (latches, hinges, locks), and truck vision systems. These are sold as products to vehicle and equipment OEMs. The two share only a broad "industrial B2B" label. Their offerings differ, their buyers differ, and so do their revenue models (processing fees versus component sales).

P2.1.text: North America's Leading Metal Coatings Company - About AZZ

P2.2.text: Learn about AZZ, North America's leading metal coatings company, delivering galvanizing, coil coating, and advanced metal coating solutions.

P2.3.text: Industry-leading provider of metal coating solutions supporting everyday life

P2.4.text: AZZ Inc. is North America’s leading independent provider of hot-dip galvanizing and coil coating solutions serving a broad range of end markets. Collectively, our business segments provide sustainable, unmatched metal coating solutions that enhance the longevity and appearance of the buildings, products and infrastructure people rely on every day.

P2.5.text: Meeting the needs of diverse and evolving markets

P2.6.text: AZZ combines large-scale galvanizing operations, integrated coil coating capabilities, and advanced surface technologies to help customers improve corrosion protection, operational efficiency, product quality, and long-term performance. Backed by an extensive network of facilities and specialized coating technologies, AZZ helps customers access the solutions, capacity, and technical support needed to meet changing business demands.

P2.7.text: North America’s largest hot-dip galvanizer of fabricated steel

P2.8.text: AZZ Galvanizing provides industry-leading corrosion protection solutions that help extend service life, reduce maintenance requirements, and improve lifecycle performance across critical infrastructure and fabricated steel applications. As North America’s largest hot-dip galvanizer, AZZ combines scalable capacity, decades of galvanizing expertise, and a commitment to consistent quality and responsive customer support.

P2.9.text: North America’s leading independent provider of coil coating services

P2.10.text: AZZ Precoat Metals delivers coil coating and value-added processing solutions engineered to increase production efficiency, product durability, and appearance performance across thousands of applications. Strategically located facilities and integrated processing capabilities help customers improve supply chain efficiency, simplify production coordination, and respond to changing manufacturing demands.

P2.11.text: Advanced surface technologies and metal finishing solutions

P2.12.text: AZZ Surface Technologies provides advanced metal finishing systems and value-added coating services tailored to environmental, performance, and industry requirements. Through automated operations, integrated coating systems, and extensive finishing expertise, AZZ simplifies coating coordination, reduces supply chain complexity, and meets accelerated project schedules through a single experienced finishing partner.

P2.13.text: Built on expertise. Focused on the future.

P2.14.text: AZZ continues to invest in advanced manufacturing technologies, sustainability initiatives, operational efficiency, and workforce development that support responsible growth across its businesses.

P2.1.text: Investors information overview | The Eastern Company

P2.4.text: The Eastern Company manages industrial businesses that design, manufacture and sell unique engineered solutions to industrial markets. We believe Eastern’s businesses operate in industries with long-term macroeconomic growth opportunities. Eastern may pursue acquisitions in industries other than those in which its businesses currently operate if an acquisition presents an attractive opportunity.

P2.5.text: Among other things, Eastern monitors financial and operational performance of each of its businesses and instills consistent financial discipline. In addition, Eastern recruits and retains talented managers to operate its businesses. We look for leaders who are accountable, maintain cost discipline, act quickly, and build strong followership.

P2.6.text: The Eastern Company consists of Big 3 Precision, Eberhard Manufacturing Company, and Velvac. These businesses design, manufacture and market a diverse product line of custom and standard vehicular and industrial hardware, including turnkey returnable packaging solutions, access and security hardware, mirrors, and mirror-cameras.

P2.7.text: Big 3 Products and Big 3 Mold’s turnkey returnable packaging solutions are used in the assembly processes of vehicles, aircraft and durable goods and in the production processes of plastic packaging products, packaged consumer goods and pharmaceuticals. Big 3 Products works with leading manufacturers to design and produce custom returnable packaging to integrate with their assembly processes. Big 3 Mold is a global leader in the design and manufacture of blow mold tools.

P2.8.text: Eberhard is a global leader in the engineering and manufacturing of access and security hardware. Eberhard offers rotary latches, compression latches, draw latches, hinges, camlocks, key switches, padlocks, and handles among other products, as well as comprehensive development and program management services for custom electromechanical and mechanical systems designed for specific original equipment manufacturers (“OEMs”) and customer applications. Eberhard’s products are found in an expansive range of applications and products globally.

P2.9.text: Velvac is the premier designer and manufacturer of proprietary vision technology for OEMs and aftermarket applications, and a leading provider of aftermarket components to the heavy-duty truck market in North America. Velvac serves diverse, niche segments within the heavy- and medium-duty truck, motorhome, and bus markets.
